name: warm_day_planned_window_no_fan_pauses
description: Warm day with windows_recommended=True and planned window 06:00–10:00. No fan is configured. Sensor opens at 08:00 (inside the window). Issue #1211 (A3): the planned window is no longer an exemption in the handler — the nat-vent entry gate runs and, with no working fan, refuses, so the handler pauses right there.
notes: The _is_within_planned_window_period() check: requires windows_recommended=True AND hvac_mode='off' AND current time between window_open_time and window_close_time.

Issue #1211 (A3, owner decision O8b): handle_door_window_open() no longer returns on it; the nat-vent entry gate decides (start nat-vent, or pause). The planned window now only exempts the lazy sync reconcile.

No fan is configured, so nat-vent is refused (no working fan) and the handler pauses. Nat-vent starting inside the period is covered by the pending scenario warm_day_planned_window_natvent_start_1211.
Covers Priority 6 warm_day_planned_window from plan abundant-mapping-clarke.md (C2×E1 cell).

events.note: Early morning: indoor 72F, outdoor 66F — conditions favorable for natural ventilation
Warm-day classification: windows recommended 06:00–10:00, hvac_mode=off for the window period
Window opens at 08:00 — inside the planned 06:00–10:00 window. Issue #1211: the handler runs the nat-vent gate (refused: no fan) and pauses.

assertions.reason: Warm-day classification applied: hvac_mode=off, windows_recommended=True with 06:00–10:00 window

sensor_open during the planned window period with no working fan: the nat-vent entry gate refuses and handle_door_window_open() pauses right there (Issue #1211 A3 / O8b). Before #1211 it returned silently.

verdict.summary: Window opened inside the planned period with no fan: the handler pauses itself (no refresh dependency)
verdict.expected_behavior: A window left open past the debounce pauses the HVAC even inside the planned window when nat-vent cannot run (household rule 3)
